notes: [cobblecap-1000 on 8cd0bc62 (wellsite-04, the fleet since 10-15 19:33Z): branch cc1000-on-8cd0bc6 @ 9e79c171] THE TOWN COBBLE CAP 256 -> 1000 (OWNER 10-14: "can we up the chest limit for cobblestones to 1000"). TOWN_COBBLE_CAP is now written once, in bots/src/stocktarget.mjs (the `cobble` group's target); cobblecap.mjs re-exports it; everything keyed off it moves with it: the deposit's and the town deposit's whole-stack admission, the journal fold's claims, the well's cobble switch (the town HOLDS its cap), the cobble prune (a stack spare only past the cap), the at-cap refusal sentence ("past its 1000 cobble (town cobble cap)"), the `_cobble_bank cap=` field. The bag's own 64 reserve is UNCHANGED. The reads take the cap from the same module (scripts/host/towncap.py; stocktargetread/stonecapread had literal 256s). WHY A CANARY: the base refuses at admission whenever a town holds 256 -- 807 `_stock_refused ... at_cobble=1` rows in 12 h on 13 of 16 pools (10-14 15:10Z - 10-15 03:10Z), and every counted town journal sits at exactly 256 (the clear's cap) or below; the base wrote ZERO _cobble_bank rows in 3 h. Expected: canary towns take cobble up to 1000 (_cobble_bank rows with town_after > 256), the at-cap refusals and the well's cobble clicks fall. Cost: 1000 cobble is 16 chest slots per town; towns hold 13-30 containers. OWNER DECISION NAMED, NOT DESIGNED HERE (Claude cc1000-r1 P2, composition): a town BELOW 1000 whose containers are all full leaves the bag's surplus cobble with no exit (no room to bank; cobble never opens a chest; the well takes cobble only once the town holds 1000; no prune). At 256 the well relieved it. Instrumented as the BANK CLOSED tripwire (deposits 'cobble never opens a new chest' DiD, no_room share); the owner may accept it or ask for the well to take cobble when the bank is closed below the cap. D1 deliberately judges EVERY canary _cobble_bank row, old-build and versionless included (a 256-build row cannot exceed 1000, so it cannot false-trip); liveness and exposure count only rows carrying cap=1000. Composition: townfloor-01 (queued) fills town ground from bag cobble above the 64 reserve; this canary moves more of that surplus into chests -- both draw on the same surplus (47,559 collected/day fleet-wide vs 13,465 held above the reserve). EVIDENCE (10-16 rebuild, r7 tips): npm test 251/251 (8cd0bc62 tip) and 252/252 (75cfb447 tip); 25 anchored mutants killed, 0 survived on each; Paper sandbox3 runs 13 and 14 (00:17Z, 01:02Z): a town of 800 counted cobble banked a whole 30-stack (server chest 800 -> 830), a town of exactly 1000 refused at admission (at_cobble=1, chest unchanged), the base 75cfb447 refused the 800 town; each bot process wrote exactly one _cobblecap_mode phase=mode cap=1000 (the licence). Reviews r1-r5 on 5e663860; r6 (rebuild) and r7 (licence row): Codex APPROVE, Claude APPROVE (docs/reports/cobblecap-1000-reviews-2026-10-15.txt).
